title: Coupling of TMEM192 antibody to MyOne™ Epoxy Dynabeads™
author: Pawel Lis

steps.title: Equilibrate beads to room temperature
steps.instruction: Allow the vial of dried magnetic beads to reach room temperature before opening.

steps.title: Thaw antibody on ice
steps.instruction: Thaw the TMEM192 antibody on ice and keep it on ice until it is added to the beads (step 8).

steps.title: Calculate antibody volume
steps.instruction: Determine the volume of antibody needed to provide 600 µg of protein; the calculated volume must not exceed 500 µL.

steps.title: Weigh beads
steps.instruction: Weigh 20 mg of MyOne™ Epoxy Dynabeads™ directly into a fresh low‑binding 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Wash beads (first wash)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 1000 µL sterile Milli‑Q water, vortex for 15 seconds, sonicate in a water‑bath sonicator for 5 minutes, place the tube on a magnetic rack for 1 minute, then remove the supernatant with a pipette. Repeat this wash once more to ensure no bead aggregates remain.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 1000 µL sterile Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Add antibody
steps.instruction: Add the calculated volume of thawed TMEM192 antibody to the washed beads.

steps.title: Add buffer C1
steps.instruction: Add buffer C1 to bring the total volume to 500 µL (C1 = 500 µL − antibody volume) and vortex to resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Add buffer C2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of buffer C2 to the tube and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Coupling incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture in a Thermomixer at 37 °C for 16–24 hours (typically 20 hours) at 1500 rpm, ensuring the beads remain in suspension and do not settle.

steps.title: Magnetic separation post‑coupling
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack for 1 minute and remove the supernatant with a pipette.

steps.title: Wash with buffer HB
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 1000 µL buffer HB, vortex, magnetically separate for 1 minute, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with buffer LB
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 1000 µL buffer LB, vortex, magnetically separate for 1 minute, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: First SB wash
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 1000 µL buffer SB, vortex, magnetically separate for 1 minute, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Second SB wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the SB wash: resuspend in 1000 µL buffer SB, vortex, magnetically separate for 1 minute, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Third SB wash
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads again in 1000 µL buffer SB and vortex (no further magnetic separation is required at this point).

steps.title: Post‑coupling shake
steps.instruction: Incubate the beads in a shaker at room temperature for 15 minutes at 1500 rpm.

steps.title: Magnetic separation after shake
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack for 1 minute and remove the supernatant with a pipette.

steps.title: Final resuspension in SBS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 1000 µL buffer SBS; the suspension now contains 20 mg/mL beads and should be stored at 4 °C. If a lower working concentration is desired, dilute the suspension with buffer SBS to 10 mg/mL.

steps.title: Final magnetic cleanup
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack for 1 minute and remove any remaining liquid with a pipette.
